crossRefs.note: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Let all the earth fear Yahweh. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.
Don’t you fear me?’ says Yahweh ‘Won’t you tremble at my presence, who have placed the sand for the bound of the sea…
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.
By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of Yahweh men depart from evil.
The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,
when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.
I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves…
“Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”
But Yahweh is in his holy temple. Let all the earth be silent before him!”
Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.”
I cry to Yahweh with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill.

translations.web: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still.
translations.bsb: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
translations.kjv: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
translations.asv: Stand in awe, and sin not: Commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
